## [1.4.1](https://github.com/jair1c/farotv-patches/compare/v1.4.0...v1.4.1) (2026-11-10)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* Also hide "Compras y membresías" when signed in ([0acad71](https://github.com/jair1c/farotv-patches/commit/0acad71ae229bef9c9da74cb9b3db03b5ad9ec45))

patches.name: Custom branding
patches.description: Changes the app name, icon, TV banner and the logo inside the app to FaroTV's (or another name).

options.description: The name shown in the TV launcher and at the top of the app.

patches.name: Disable start on boot
patches.description: Keeps the app (and MicroG-RE) from starting in the background when the TV is switched on.

patches.name: FaroTV settings and scripts
patches.description: Adds a "FaroTV" section to YouTube's Settings with switches to hide Shorts, hide the topic tabs and block video ads.

patches.name: GmsCore support
patches.description: Redirects the app's Google Play Services calls to GmsCore (MicroG-RE). Requires MicroG-RE to be installed. Without it, YouTube for Android TV crashes because Google Play Services rejects DroidGuard for the new package name.

patches.name: Run without Google Play Services
patches.description: Changes the package name so the patched app installs next to the original one, and keeps it running when Google Play Services rejects the new package name. Sign in with an activation code (yt.be/activate).

patches.name: Spoof device
patches.description: Reports another TV model to YouTube, so it runs on TVs it calls "not compatible". Default: Google Chromecast.
